suite: BioNexus Benchmark Suite v1.0 external reference concordance

experiments.name: ADMET core descriptor concordance
experiments.reference: independent calls to the same installed RDKit public descriptor functions
experiments.scope_note: Only deterministic RDKit-derived quantities are validated here. Heuristic ADMET/toxicity labels are not treated as experimentally validated predictions.

experiments.name: RCSB structure retrieval byte/record concordance
experiments.scope_note: This validates identifier/retrieval integrity, not structural preparation or biological correctness.

experiments.name: Live EBI BLAST known-sequence recovery
experiments.query: human hemoglobin beta UniProt P68871 sequence
experiments.scope_note: Database releases can change ranking. The pre-specified criterion is exact target recovery among the first five hits with >=99% identity, not a fixed rank claim.

experiments.name: Primer3 integration parity
experiments.scope_note: This validates preservation of Primer3 output for a fixed template and parameter set; it does not establish universal primer specificity or wet-lab performance.

experiments.name: Clustal Omega MSA integration parity
experiments.reference: independent EMBL-EBI Clustal Omega REST job
experiments.scope_note: Parity is defined on parsed aligned sequences from two independent EBI jobs using identical inputs. It does not claim one MSA algorithm is biologically superior to another.

claim_boundary: These results validate deterministic descriptor parity, selected UniProt parsing, RCSB retrieval integrity, one live BLAST recovery case, fixed-input Primer3 integration parity, and one Clustal Omega MSA parity case. They do not validate heuristic ADMET endpoints, docking pose accuracy, structure preparation, NGS clinical performance, wet-lab primer performance, or AI interpretation.
